model_match.note: Matched against the 0x6D product-info model string (first token, before '-' or space), as NibePi does.

firmware.note: Sources do not state firmware ranges. ModbusManager DB 8310 (2020-06-24).

semantics.value: engineering_value = raw / scale (raw interpreted per data_type, little-endian)
semantics.raw_min_max: raw (unscaled) limits from the source; null = not specified
semantics.access: what the SOURCE claims; the gateway never writes based on this (write_allowed is always false)
semantics.verification: unverified for every entry until confirmed on the owner's F730 (see docs/research/register-catalog.md)
semantics.sentinels: HYPOTHESIS: raw values at the integer limit (s16 -32768, u16 65535, u8 255, s8 -128, s32 -2^31, u32 2^32-1) mean 'no value' (yozik04/nibe encoders.py)

notes: Not in the F730 ModbusManager export nor in NibePi; known only from community data.
MODBUS40 word swap; changes 32-bit word order in read responses. NibePi writes 0 on every start. Read it, never write it.

registers.name: modbus40-disable-log-set-48889
registers.title: MODBUS40 Disable LOG.SET
registers.description: If set, the system will ignore the existing LOG.SET on the USB stick.1=ignore LOG.SET,0=use LOG.SET
notes: Not in the F730 ModbusManager export nor in NibePi; known only from community data.
yozik04/nibe lists value labels: {"0": "use LOG.SET", "1": "ignore LOG.SET"}
MODBUS40 disable LOG.SET (USB stick register selection for data messages). Never write.
